picks.title: Shivaji (Indian king)

picks.title: Peshwa (Maratha chief minister)

picks.title: Maratha
picks.why: It should situate Pune within the Maratha polity that made the city a capital.

picks.title: Battle of Wadgaon (Indian history [1779])

picks.title: Battle of Kirkee (British-Indian history)
picks.why: The 1817 defeat near Pune was decisive in the Marathas' loss of power and the city's transformation.

picks.title: Poona Sarvajanik Sabha (Indian political association)
picks.why: It should document a major civic institution founded in Pune and the city's role in public politics.

picks.title: Sahyadri / Western Ghats
picks.why: It should establish Pune's position against the Sahyadri and Western Ghats landscape.

picks.title: Giant Metrewave Wavelength Telescope (telescope, Pune, India)
picks.why: It should anchor a modern scientific landmark in the Pune area on the present-day map.
